messages:
deploy-bot: deploy started: release=release-2026-03-18 artifact=redwood-model:v3-ci-tag target=canary-eu-2

alice (oncall): paging: spikes in 5xxs on canary-eu-2 /v1/chat, lots of tokenizer errors in logs like 'unknown token id 65536'

mike (sre): looking into logs now. stack shows weight load plus tokenizer init failing: 'expected vocab_size=50257 got=32768'

sarah (ml-infra): that error means the tokenizer vocab doesn't match model embedding dims. CI must have promoted a weight bundle from the smaller model under the v3 tag. we need to stop the rollout immediately\n

jordan (prod-eng): flipping feature flag to stop canary routing: redwoodctl traffic set --route canary-eu-2 --variant fallback:v2-compat

jordan (prod-eng): flag flipped. routing reverted to fallback variant. monitoring now.

incident-bot: @alice acknowledged the pager (incident id INC-20260318-91). Severity=P1. On-call shift: alice -> mike in 15m if unresolved.

alice (oncall): confirmed fallback in place. 5xx rate down from 9% -> 1.2% over 45s. some in-flight requests still failing.

sarah (ml-infra): please apply global release kill-switch for release-2026-03-18: set releases.release-2026-03-18.enabled=false. Also schedule cache invalidation on eu nodes to evict any partially loaded params.

jordan (prod-eng): running kill-switch: `redwoodctl releases disable release-2026-03-18 --reason "artifact mismatch: wrong tokenizer/weights"`

deploy-bot: release=release-2026-03-18 disabled by jordan at 2026-03-18T09:24:12Z

mike (sre): recommending rollback of canary instances to previous image and a coordinated redeploy after artifact validation. tagging build/ci to hold promotions.

sarah (ml-infra): invalidating KV caches on affected nodes and restarting workers now: ```infractl cache invalidate --pattern kv_model_* --region eu --reason "mis-sharded artifact" && infractl rolling-restart --group canary-eu-2```

liz (customer-success): Heads up: one enterprise customer (acme-analytics) has long-running batch jobs against canary-eu-2. CS is reaching out to confirm if they saw errors. I'll standby for affected request ids.

tina (pm): please capture timeline snippets: deploy request 09:22:09Z, first errors 09:22:47Z, fallback routing 09:23:10Z, kill-switch 09:24:12Z. Need quick impact matrix and list of affected API keys.

alice (oncall): running query to pull requests to canary-eu-2 with 5xx between 09:22:30Z-09:24:30Z. pushing output to incident doc and pinging CS.

sarah (ml-infra): root cause hypothesis: release pipeline incorrectly resolved artifact aliases; the v3 alias pointed to a legacy weightset. action items: add SHA256 verification of weight bundles, add a small smoke test that loads tokenizer+weights and checks embedding dims before promotion. filing GH issue.

mike (sre): I'm taking incident lead. alice, handoff in 10m. I'll coordinate log collection, rollback verification, and postmortem.

alice (oncall): handing off to mike. everyone react with :eyes: when you are watching.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260318-91 updated: lead=mike, status=mitigated, mitigation=route-fallback+kill-switch, next_action=postmortem+artifact-validation

sarah (ml-infra): created GH issue redwood/release-pipeline#493 - "enforce artifact hash & smoke-load on promotion" assigned to @sarah, priority=high

liz (customer-success): noted. I'll prepare customer comms and notify acme-analytics; will request list of affected request ids from the incident doc.

mike (sre): quick checklist before we close: hold CI promotions for v3 tags, validate all artifacts referenced by release-2026-03-18, run smoke-load in staging for tokenizer/weights dim checks, and schedule a 30m postmortem in channel. reconvene in 30m.
